name: Time: the repository's history as a local big bang, initial objects, forward steps, postmodern-safe claims

infinity.family: preorders on n elements, every n
infinity.reduction: a least element is unique up to isomorphism: if a and b are both least then a <= b and b <= a (two lines, written in time/BASE.md section 2); counted exactly for n <= 4

infinity.family: stores of any size and any sequence of forward steps
infinity.reduction: a forward step only sets records to verified, so by induction on the number of steps a verified record stays verified (time/BASE.md section 3); exhaustive for 4 records and 4 steps

infinity.family: posets on n worlds, every n
infinity.reduction: symmetric plus antisymmetric forces a = b for every edge (a, b), so the only symmetric poset is the identity; exhaustive for n <= 4

infinity.family: the future of the repository's history
infinity.reduction: the check runs on HEAD as it is; later commits are not known

checks.statement: the history to HEAD has one root, is acyclic, every commit reaches the root; a longest root-to-HEAD path is computed and confirmed
preorders on 1..4: 1, 4, 29, 355; with a least element 1, 3, 16, 145; unique up to isomorphism
only passing checks: settled stays settled, 6558 toy cases; a failing re-check breaks it
every version of every */findings.jsonl in git: records removed and downgraded counted
no poset on 1..4 worlds with an edge is symmetric (242 posets)
T, 4, []<>T, ~(p&~p) valid on all S4 and S5 frames on 1..3 worlds; B, 5, .2 on S5 only

arrows.what: the kripke and check lines of asteroid state the frame claims exactly
DAG.lean (rejoining histories) and Fisher.lean lost_mono: the git history is a DAG; settled-stays-settled is lost_mono's shape for verified records
the alpha line as the alpha timeline; commits off it as doomed branches
